content: As shown in Table TABREF35, content words are more important on Chinese$\Rightarrow $English but content-free words are more important on English$\Rightarrow $Japanese. On English$\Rightarrow $French, there is no notable increase or decrease of the distribution since English and French are in essence very similar. We also obtain some specific findings of great interest. For example, we find that noun is more important on Chinese$\Rightarrow $English translation, while preposition is more important on English$\Rightarrow $French translation. More interestingly, English$\Rightarrow $Japanese translation shows a substantial discrepancy in contrast to the other two language pairs. The results reveal that preposition and punctuation are very important in English$\Rightarrow $Japanese translation, which is counter-intuitive.
